GM Overrides

- Keeper Mara is friendly to the party and will quietly open the bell tower cellar.
- The burgomaster no longer controls the town watch; Captain Soren does.
- The relic under the tower was moved to the Blue Lantern inn cellar last session.
- The bell tower bells were already rung once during the riot, so the seal is no longer intact.

Priority note: session changes and GM overrides take precedence over the official excerpt.
